Be currently enrolled at UCR as a full-time undergraduate student for the entire 2026-27 academic year

ig_ideasandsociety_p4022411233478138146.description:
Calling UC Graduate Students!

The Center invites presentation proposals from UC graduate students for the 4th Annual UC Graduate Student Virtual Conference on March 5, 2027, on the theme “States of Exception, States of Emergence.” The UC Graduate Student Virtual Conference is an annual venue for humanities and humanities-related research from graduate students across the UC system. Hosted online and organized by themes, the gathering amplifies emerging work, connects scholars across campuses and system, and celebrates the varieties of methods and approaches in humanities-based research.

Conference Date: March 5, 2027
Proposal Deadline: January 18, 2027
Learn more and apply: ideasandsociety.ucr.edu/soe2027

ig_inlandcivrights_p4014438963351446444.title: Photography Beyond Sight: Bruce Hall and Kurt Weston in Conversation
ig_inlandcivrights_p4014438963351446444.description:
📷Photography Beyond Sight: Bruce Hall and Kurt Weston📷 in Conversation invites audiences into a powerful conversation with blind photographers, Bruce Hall and Kurt Weston, who are redefining how we understand image-making, perception, and creativity. Join us on 📅 Thursday, November 5 from ⏰ 6:00 - 8:00 PM where you’ll have an opportunity to listen to their personal stories and artistic insights and see the work of blind photographers in Sight Unseen Reframed, an internationally-known exhibition originally curated by Douglas McCulloh. 

✨Photographers will share their creative processes, the role of assistive technologies in their work, and the unique perspectives they bring to storytelling through images. This program offers an opportunity to reflect on access, innovation, and the many ways art can be experienced beyond the visual. Join us for an engaging and thought-provoking dialogue that centers lived experience, artistic expression, and the limitless possibilities of seeing differently. ✨
ig_inlandcivrights_p4014438963351446444.location: 3933 Mission Inn Avenue, Ste 102 Riverside, CA 92501

ig_pcachagas_p4020304930157489331.title: CO-CREATING WITH AI: Sound, Image, and Embodiment
ig_pcachagas_p4020304930157489331.description:
CO-CREATING WITH AI: Sound, Image, and Embodiment

📅 Friday, November 6, 2026
🕛 12:00–3:20 PM
📍 Orbach Library, Room 122 | UC Riverside

What happens when AI enters artistic practice not as a substitute for human creativity, but as a space for experimentation, collaboration, and critical reflection?

Building on the interdisciplinary dialogue initiated by Co-Creativity in Music, Sound, and AI (CCMSAI), this workshop explores emerging relationships among sound, image, gesture, embodiment, and artificial intelligence.

Through interactive installations, hands-on workshops, and student exhibitions, we invite participants to experience and question the creative possibilities of AI while keeping human agency, artistic imagination, and collaboration at the center.

Organized collaboratively by UCR Music, UCR Library, and the Center for Ideas and Society, in cooperation with RAISE@UCR.

Join us for an afternoon of artistic discovery and interdisciplinary exchange!

#CoCreatingWithAI #CCMSAI #UCR #DigitalHumanities #HumanAICollaboration

ig_ppacatucr_p3967299132067617578.title: Fall 2026 Pre-Law Conference
ig_ppacatucr_p3967299132067617578.description:
The University of California, Riverside (UCR) Pre-Professional Advising Center and the College of Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences (CHASS), in partnership with the Hispanic National Bar Association (HNBA), are excited to host the inaugural Fall 2026 Pre-Law Conference.

This free, one-day conference will bring together law school admissions professionals, practicing attorneys, judges, legal scholars, and other leaders from across the legal profession to help students and community members explore careers in law. Sessions will cover topics including preparing for law school, succeeding during the first year (1L), judicial clerkships, emerging areas of legal practice, and professional networking.

Attendees will also have the opportunity to connect with law school admissions representatives, LSAT preparation providers, and practicing attorneys during a networking luncheon and resource fair. Whether you're just beginning to explore a legal career or preparing to apply to law school, this conference offers valuable insights, practical guidance, and meaningful connections to help you take the next step.

Again, this community conference is FREE and OPEN TO ALL.

To help prepare for seating and refreshments/lunch, please RSVP today!

RSVP Link: https://events.ucr.edu/event/fall-2026-pre-law-conference

ig_ppacatucr_p3999174072773350700-202611.title: Ph.D. in Public Health Sciences Recruitment Webinar
ig_ppacatucr_p3999174072773350700-202611.description:
The UC Davis Department of Public Health Sciences is pleased to share that the 2027 applications are now open for our Master of Public Health (MPH) and Ph.D. in Public Health Sciences programs. We would appreciate your help sharing these opportunities with students, alumni, and others in your community who may be interested in pursuing graduate training in public health.
Master of Public Health (MPH)
The UC Davis MPH is an accelerated program that begins in August and is completed the following spring. Students can choose between a Generalist or Epidemiology track and receive interdisciplinary training in core areas of public health. The program also includes an applied practicum experience, allowing students to put their training into practice in a professional public health setting.
Ph.D. in Public Health Sciences
The UC Davis Ph.D. in Public Health Sciences prepares students to become independent public health researchers and leaders. Students receive rigorous training in epidemiology, biostatistics, research design, and advanced research methods while developing specialized expertise through individualized areas of concentration and close faculty mentorship.

ig_ppacatucr_p4006592835918157858.title: UCR/HNBA Pre-Law Conference
ig_ppacatucr_p4006592835918157858.description:
The University of California, Riverside (UCR) Pre-Professional Advising Center and the College of Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences (CHASS), in partnership with the Hispanic National Bar Association (HNBA), are excited to host the inaugural Fall 2026 Pre-Law Conference.

This free, one-day conference will bring together law school admissions professionals, practicing attorneys, judges, legal scholars, and other leaders from across the legal profession to help students and community members explore careers in law. Sessions will cover topics including preparing for law school, succeeding during the first year (1L), judicial clerkships, emerging areas of legal practice, and professional networking.

Attendees will also have the opportunity to connect with law school admissions representatives, LSAT preparation providers, and practicing attorneys during a networking luncheon and resource fair. Whether you’re just beginning to explore a legal career or preparing to apply to law school, this conference offers valuable insights, practical guidance, and meaningful connections to help you take the next step.

Again, this community conference is FREE and OPEN TO ALL.

To help prepare for seating and refreshments/lunch, please RSVP today!

RSVP Link: https://events.ucr.edu/event/fall-2026-pre-law-conference

ig_smiatucr_p4002917644475874811-2026103.title: CalTeach-SMI Tier I Scholarship Informational Session
ig_smiatucr_p4002917644475874811-2026103.description:
📣SENIORS!📣 SMI has a bunch of resources to help you through this application season!!

Starting with the TEP Guest Speaker Series! ⭐️⭐️⭐️ We'll be having application experts and program advisors from Cal State San Bernardo, UC Riverside, and University of Redlands speak about their school's credential programs (and joint masters is available👀). Come meet them and ask any questions you have  about the application process or program! Also, by attending at least 1 event qualifies you for the next 2 resources!

Next up, SMI offers a 💸TEP Application Fee Reimbursement💸 for up to 2 qualifying programs. However, you must have gone to a guest speaker event this quarter (Fall '26) so don't forget to sign up!

Furthermore, by going to at least 1 guest speaker meeting, you'll be invited to a senior only Q&A event with current TEP students and SMI Alumni 🤩🤩. There you'll be able to hear about current firsthand experience within different credential programs!

Lastly, SMI is offering a 💸scholarship opportunity💸 for students who plan on attending UCR's TEP with multiple merit-based awards up to $18,000 each!!! To learn more about this application process, the director of SMI will be hosting 2 Info. Sessions to walk you through the application and answer any questions you might have. 

Seniors, we know you're going to succeed and we're only here to help so take advantage of your resources!! 🍎🫂

ig_ucralumni_p4002268883124628928.title: Write to Lead: Build Your Influence Professional Development Webinar
ig_ucralumni_p4002268883124628928.description:
Many professionals have valuable expertise, strong perspectives, innovative ideas, and years of experience, but very little of that knowledge exists publicly. 

This session shows participants how intentional publishing can help make professional expertise easier to discover and evaluate. The goal is not to turn everyone into a professional writer. The goal is to help professionals become findable for what they know.

In this webinar, we will:
▫️Understand how publishing can strengthen professional visibility and credibility.
▫️Identify practical publishing formats, from LinkedIn posts to op-eds and industry features.
▫️Turn professional experience into useful article ideas.
▫️Use LinkedIn strategically to extend the reach of original ideas.
▫️Create a realistic 30-day publishing and visibility plan

Moderated by Tamra Simpson ‘11, UC Riverside Black Alumni Chapter. 

Register at alumni.ucr.edu/writetolead.

ig_ucrbasicneeds_p4011569920509396146-20.description:
Thinking about applying for CalFresh? Now’s the time! CalFresh Outreach Week | Oct 26th - Oct 30th Meet with our team, learn if you’re eligible, and get help every step of the way. 

#calfresh #basicneeds #ucr #bnc 

Inland Counties Legal Services (ICLS) is a nonprofit law firm that provides free civil legal help to low-income residents of Riverside and San Bernardino counties.
Our attorneys assist with issues such as housing and tenant rights, public benefits (including CalFresh, CalWORKs, and Medi-Cal), consumer and debt problems, family law and domestic violence restraining orders, and disaster-related legal needs.
At the event, we can share information about our services and answer general questions about whether ICLS may be able to help with a legal issue a student or their family is facing. We will also have materials explaining how to contact ICLS to apply for assistance.  CalFresh interns will help students assist for CalFresh! Interns are able to pre-screen and answer any questions.

CalFresh interns will be at the Bell Tower to answer questions, conduct pre-screens and share out resources!
Come by for information and merch!

Light refreshment will be provided to all students that get pre-screened for CalFresh by a CalFresh intern. Students will be able to make appointments for our Skip the Wait, Get Approved Today event that will be on 11/05.

Join us on October 29th for a special CalFresh event where county workers will be on campus to help you complete your application and interview on the spot!
✅Get screened
✅Complete your interview
✅Receive your EBT card the same day if approved!

Appointments HIGHLY recommended, very limited walk-ins available

CalFresh interns will be available to help students apply for CalFresh and answer questions!

ig_ucrblack_p4014561798740537233.description:
ATTENTION UCR UNDERGRADUATES! THE BLACK ALUMNI CHAPTER SCHOLARSHIP IS NOW OPEN!

Invest in your future while continuing to make a difference in our community.

Established in 2020 by the UC Riverside Black Alumni Chapter (BAC), the Black Alumni Chapter Scholarship supports student leaders who are passionate about uplifting, empowering, and creating positive change within the Black community.

Are you making an impact on campus or in your community? Your leadership matters, and this is an opportunity to support your academic journey while continuing to make a difference.

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

* Currently enrolled as a full-time UCR undergraduate student for the entire 2026–2027 academic year
* Minimum 2.5 GPA
* Demonstrated commitment to creating positive change within the Black community

APPLICATION DEADLINE: November 22, 2026

READY TO APPLY?

Find the scholarship application link in our bio! Log in with your CAS credentials, complete Duo authentication, and submit your application.

Know a UCR student who should apply? Share this post and help spread the word. Let’s continue investing in the next generation of Black leaders.

#UCR #UCRiverside #BlackAlumniChapter #BlackExcellence

The Buscadores (Searchers) Program supports all students writing application materials for graduate school, medical school, law school, and other prestigious professional opportunities. Experienced University Writing faculty guide students searching for future careers that require advanced degrees. We teach students how to navigate the hidden curriculum of application essays. We provide equitable and inclusive opportunities for success by offering weekly workshops, writing labs, and 1-on-1 faculty mentoring tailored to fit student schedules. We welcome and support UCR students at any stage of the writing process!

Buscadores is free of charge and open to all current and former UCR students. https://uwp.ucr.edu/buscadores

ig_ucrleadershipandservice_p402898966627.title: Highlanders Give Back 2026
ig_ucrleadershipandservice_p402898966627.description:
🍂❤️ LOOKING BACK: HIGHLANDERS GIVE BACK 2025! 💙🍂
73 Highlanders. 360 meals served. Countless moments of community connection. 🫶

Last November, UCR students came together at Lincoln Park in Riverside to help make the annual Thanksgiving dinner a success! In partnership with the City of Riverside Parks, Recreation & Community Services division, our Highlander volunteers: 🍂 

Prepared food and helped get Thanksgiving dinner ready 🦃 Decorated and prepared the venue 🍽️ Served 360 FREE meals to community members ⚽ Played soccer and connected with local kids! Helped clean up and wrap up the event

With 73 student volunteers, including members of UCR fraternities and sororities and the Women’s Soccer team, our Highlanders dedicated a total of 9 hours across various shifts to giving back to the Riverside community!

Our 2025 event even received a feature in Inside UCR! 📰
✨ NOW IT’S YOUR TURN TO BE PART OF THE IMPACT!

Join us for Highlanders Give Back 2026 on Friday, November 20! We’re looking to fill the LAST 6 SPOTS for our second shift! PLUS, volunteers receive a FREE insulated tote AND a FREE volunteer T-shirt! 🎁
📍 Lincoln Park, Riverside 📅 Friday, November 20, 2026
⚠️ Transportation to and from the volunteer site is NOT provided. Volunteers are responsible for arranging their own transportation.
Let’s make another year of giving back one to remember! 💛💙
🔗 https://volunteer.ucr.edu/need/detail/?need_id=1159714
